meta.name: azure-kubernetes
meta.description: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. Covers Day-0 checklist, SKU selection (Automatic vs Standard), networking options (private API server, Azure CNI Overlay, egress configuration), security, and operations (autoscaling, upgrade strategy, cost analysis). WHEN: create AKS environment, provision AKS, enable AKS observability, design AKS networking, choose AKS SKU, secure AKS, optimize AKS, AKS spot nodes, AKS cluster-autoscaler, rightsize AKS pod, pod rightsizing, over-provisioned AKS pod, pod resource requests and limits, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, VPA recommendations.

copy.tagline: 规划、创建并配置生产就绪的 AKS 集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要部署和管理 Azure 上的 Kubernetes 集群
copy.tagline_en: Plan, create, and configure production-ready AKS clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters on Azure

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你规划、创建和配置生产级 Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) 集群，包括选择 SKU、设计网络、设置安全与监控、制定升级策略，并给出成本优化建议。
howto.when: 当你提到创建 AKS 环境、配置 AKS 网络、选择 AKS SKU、优化 AKS 成本等关键词，或要求规划 AKS 集群时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个生产级 AKS 集群，使用自动 SKU。
say.note: Claude 会给出 Day-0 决策清单和推荐配置。

say.text: 如何为 AKS 配置 Azure CNI Overlay 网络？
say.note: Claude 会解释网络模型并给出创建命令。

say.text: 我的 AKS 节点池需要启用节点自动预配。
say.note: Claude 会指导启用 NAP 并说明好处。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including SKU selection, networking design, security and observability setup, upgrade strategy, and cost optimization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention creating an AKS environment, configuring AKS networking, choosing an AKS SKU, optimizing AKS costs, or planning an AKS cluster.

say_en.text: Help me plan a production AKS cluster using Automatic SKU.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a Day-0 checklist and recommended configuration.

say_en.text: How do I configure Azure CNI Overlay networking for AKS?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the network model and provide creation commands.

say_en.text: I need to enable Node Auto Provisioning on my AKS node pool.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through enabling NAP and explain its benefits.
